category: IP geolocation and VPN detection API

free_tier.stated: a free tier with an API key and no credit card; its allowance is not published; a keyless single lookup answers HTTP 401; plans from EUR 10 a month for 100,000 requests
free_tier.notes: unverified: the free allowance; no page states a number. Medium is EUR 20 a month for 300,000 requests and Large EUR 49 for 1,000,000.

per_object_cap.stated: one IP per GET /api/v1/ip/{ip}; POST /api/v1/ip/batch takes up to 100 IPs

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://ip-api.io/api/v1/ip/{ip}?api_key={key} answers JSON with location, ISP, ASN and suspicious_factors; POST https://ip-api.io/api/v1/ip/batch takes up to 100 IPs, and the key is optional there
tooling: any HTTP client or the official SDKs
chaining: Location plus VPN, proxy, Tor and threat flags in one answer; the free allowance is unpublished, so the paid plans from EUR 10 a month are the stated working route. Bulk path: POST /api/v1/ip/batch, up to 100 IPs, one credit per unique IP.

limits.value: unverified: the free tier's allowance is not published
up to 100 IPs per batch request

binding_note: the free allowance is unpublished; the paid plans are metered in requests a month.

identity_cost.detail: first name, last name, email and password on the sign-up form; no credit card required

reliability_note: a keyless single lookup answers HTTP 401 Valid API key is required; anonymous batch requests are rate limited per IP with no published limit
confidence_note: The home, product, bulk and sign-up pages were quoted on 2026-11-02 and a keyless single lookup answered HTTP 401; no keyed lookup was made and no page states the free allowance, so it is unverified.
